mapper.select:
select t1.CDATE as cdate, t1.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, t1.CCY as ccy, t1.TDY_ASSET_NETVALUE as tdyAssetNetvalue, t1.TDY_ASSET_VALUE as tdyAssetValue, t1.CREATE_USER as createUser, t1.CREATE_DEPT as createDept, t1.CREATE_TIME as createTime, t1.UPDATE_USER as updateUser, t1.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, t5.NUM_AMT as tdyShareAmt, /*fixed WZZGBS-592 bug*/ CASE WHEN t5.NUM_AMT is not null THEN round(t1.TDY_ASSET_NETVALUE/t5.NUM_AMT,8) ELSE 0 END as tdyUnitValue, CASE WHEN t5.NUM_AMT is not null THEN round(t1.TDY_ASSET_NETVALUE/t5.NUM_AMT+nvl(t1.TOT_BOUNS_AMT,0),8) ELSE 0 END as tdyUnitValueSum, t1.BENCHMARK_RATE as benchmarkRate, nvl(t3.SEVEN_DAY_RATE,0) as yield7, t1.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP as tdyUnpaidIntincexp, t1.TDY_UNPAID_PROFIT as tdyUnpaidProfit, t1.TOT_BOUNS_AMT as totBounsAmt, t1.DELAY_PAY_AMT as delayPayAmt from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION t1 LEFT JOIN fin_product t2 ON t1.portfolio_id = t2.finprod_market_id and t2.finprod_type2 = 'F16' LEFT JOIN BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS t3 ON t2.finprod_id = t3.finprod_id and t3.val_date = t1.cdate LEFT JOIN BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS_ADD t4 ON t2.finprod_id = t4.finprod_id and t4.val_date = t1.cdate LEFT JOIN BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA t5 ON t2.finprod_id = t5.BOOKSET_ID and t5.val_date = t1.cdate and t5.detail_dist = '02' where 1=1
AND t1.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND t1.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND t1.CDATE < to_date(#{sysdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

select PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, CDATE as cdate, PTL_FEE_TYPE as ptlFeeType, sum(nvl(TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) as tdyIntervalPayFee, '999999' as ptlFeePlace, O_CCY as oCcy from PTL_FEE_POSITION where 1=1
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_TYPE!='C04'/*组合头寸的浮动管理费与产品端浮动管理费记重，去除*/ group by PTL_FEE_POSITION.Cdate,PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_TYPE,PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID,PTL_FEE_POSITION.O_CCY union all select ptl_portfolio.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, CDATE as cdate, FEE_TYPE as ptlFeeType, sum(nvl(TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP,0)) as tdyIntervalPayFee, '999999' as ptlFeePlace, ptl_portfolio.ccy as oCcy from BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE left join fin_product fp on BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.Finprod_Id=fp.Finprod_Id left join ptl_portfolio on ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID/*修复费用头寸与组合代码关联不正确问题*/ where 1=1
AND ptl_portfolio.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
group by BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.Cdate,BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FEE_TYPE,ptl_portfolio.PORTFOLIO_ID,ptl_portfolio.ccy

select ptl_cash_position.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, sum(ptl_cash_position.AMOUNT) as amount, ptl_cash_position.CCY as ccy from ptl_cash_position where 1=1
AND ptl_cash_position.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ptl_cash_position.CDATE = to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND ptl_cash_position.HODING_TYPE = #{HODING_TYPE} group by ptl_cash_position.CCY, ptl_cash_position.PORTFOLIO_ID
